## Summary

- Describe the user-visible or maintainer-facing change.

## Verification

- List the exact commands and results.
- Include screenshots for visible UI changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and targets `dev`.
- [ ] Behavior changes include regression coverage.
- [ ] Documentation or release notes were updated when needed.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes were reviewed for unsafe inputs, secrets, and permissions.
- [ ] All actionable CodeRabbit findings are fixed or answered with rationale.
